{{Quote|A treasure vessel, carrying the plunder of many worlds.|Thrawn|<ref name="Outbound Flight (novel)" />}}
'''Vagaari plunder ships''' were used<ref name="Outbound Flight (novel)" /> around [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]]<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of [[Outbound Flight (novel)|''Outbound Flight'']] to [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]].</ref> by the [[Vagaari Empire]] to temporarily store and transport all types of valuable objects stolen from defeated [[Starship/Legends|starships]] and other civilizations. They were maintained by slaves captured from the Vagaari's raids. A large Vagaari plunder ship was once captured by the [[Chiss Expansionary Defense Force]] with a main storage area that stretched out over two decks and was filled with coins, jewels, [[Spice/Legends|spices]], artwork and other treasures from many worlds.<ref name="Outbound Flight (novel)" />
